articles.body: Most Google Workspace tenants at small businesses were set up in an afternoon, years ago, by whoever was handy. The defaults are reasonable, but "reasonable" leaves gaps: one super admin with SMS codes, mail forwarding open to anyone, Drive links shared with "anyone on the internet", and OAuth apps nobody remembers approving. Every path starts from the Google Admin console (admin.google.com) and was checked against Google's current admin help pages in October 2026. Google moves menus around, so if a path doesn't match, search the setting name in the console's search bar. Before you start Use a super admin account , but not your daily one if you can avoid it.

articles.title: Node.js Express Retention Governance — Daily Cleanup of Old Marketplace Records
articles.excerpt: Short answer: schedule the marketplace cleanup after nightly payment reconciliation, but let durable settlement evidence — not the cron expression — decide which old uploads, logs, and records may be…
articles.body: Short answer: schedule the marketplace cleanup after nightly payment reconciliation, but let durable settlement evidence — not the cron expression — decide which old uploads, logs, and records may be deleted. Use the simplest external scheduler that can identify a missed business date, and make every retry present the same dated run key to an idempotent worker. This order matters because age is a poor proxy for business completion. A seller document can be old while its payout is disputed. A provider-response log can look disposable while it remains the only correlation evidence for an unmatched transaction. If a second trigger arrives, it must rediscover the same decisions rather than create a second version of the night. Retention rules precede scheduling Start with a deletion contract.

articles.body: 7,600 fake repositories shipped in 2026, with 800 posing as AI skills and MCP servers. Security researchers at Island documented a campaign where coding assistants surfaced malicious repos without any attacker-supplied link. Ask Claude or Gemini for a "free Walmart MCP server" and you might get an attacker's repo as the top recommendation. RepoPilot is a serverless agent that scores any public GitHub repository before you clone it. Built on AWS Lambda and Bedrock, it returns a 0-100 risk score, flags dangerous install steps, and provides a sanitized setup path. The architecture shows how to build a developer-workflow gatekeeper that runs in under two minutes without standing infrastructure. articles.title: Toll Road Text Scam: 'Unpaid Toll' Smishing Texts That Steal Your Payment Info
articles.excerpt: The toll road text scam may be the most widely seen phone scam in America right now. It arrives as a text message claiming you owe a small unpaid toll — often around $12.51 — and warning of a $50 late…
articles.body: The toll road text scam may be the most widely seen phone scam in America right now. It arrives as a text message claiming you owe a small unpaid toll — often around $12.51 — and warning of a $50 late fee unless you pay immediately through a link. Millions of people have received some version of it, including many who have never driven on a toll road in their lives. The text looks official, the amount seems too small to question, and the link takes you to a page dressed up like your state’s toll agency. None of it is real: the page is built to harvest your credit card number, and sometimes your driver’s license number and Social Security number as well. This is not a small-time operation.

articles.title: Why I Built a Zero-Cost GCC Labour Law & Financial Calculator Hub
articles.excerpt: Calculating statutory dues across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) has always been surprisingly fragmented. Most expatriates and small business owners rely either on decade-old Excel templates or ou…
articles.body: Calculating statutory dues across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) has always been surprisingly fragmented. Most expatriates and small business owners rely either on decade-old Excel templates or outdated web forms that miscalculate legal formulas. For example, under Kuwait Labour Law No. 6/2010 (Article 55), computing an employee daily wage requires dividing the basic salary by 26 working days. Yet, almost every standard online calculator divides it by 30 calendar days, creating substantial accounting discrepancies. Similarly, the transition between Oman Royal Decree 35/2003 and Royal Decree 53/2023 requires a clear split calculation for service tenures. To solve this, I engineered GulfCalc , an unmetered, privacy-first web property dedicated to GCC statutory mathematics.

articles.title: 8 Classic PlayStation Adventure Games that are Barely Playable Today
articles.excerpt: From Tomb Raider to Silent Hill, eight classic PlayStation games whose tank controls, cameras, or lost code make them hard to play today
articles.body: If you’ve ever watched someone play an old PlayStation game and wondered why their character keeps spinning around in circles, congratulations, you’ve already met tank controls. If you’re unfamiliar, here’s your quick introduction: With tank controls, pressing up moves your character forward in whatever direction they’re facing, and pressing left or right only rotates them, so with the stick alone, you can’t sidestep or turn on a dime. That’s manageable in a hallway. It’s much less so when you’re sneaking past a guard, lining up a shot, or timing a leap across a pit, which is why the same scheme caused trouble in just about every genre during the PS1 era. These eight classic games are the hardest to go back to, whether the culprit is tank controls or something else entirely.

articles.title: Japan launches historic MMX sample-return mission to Mars' moon Phobos (video)

articles.body: Japan's groundbreaking mission to Mars is officially underway, headed to the Red Planet's mysterious moons Phobos and Deimos for a historic sample-return attempt. The Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission launched today (Oct. 19) from Tanegashima Space Center in Japan, riding an H3 rocket that lifted off from Pad-2 at Tanegashima's Yoshinobu Launch Complex at 3:41 p.m. EDT (1941 GMT; 4:41 a.m. local time in Japan on Oct. 20). The JAXA ( Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency )-led MMX mission is bound for Mars orbit, where it will study the planet's two moons, Phobos and Deimos.

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 19, 2016: Europe's ExoMars orbiter and Schiaparelli lander arrive at Mars
articles.excerpt: On Oct. 19, 2016, the European Space Agency's ExoMars orbiter and Schiaparelli arrived at Mars! Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Oct. 19, 2016, the European Space Agency's ExoMars mission arrived at Mars ! ExoMars 2016 consists of the Trace Gas Orbiter and the Schiaparelli lander. The orbiter and lander traveled there together and separated on Oct. 16, three days before the orbiter entered orbit around Mars , and the lander touched down on the planet's surface. But something went wrong during the lander's descent, and it crashed into the ground. Schiaparelli did not survive the accident , but the Trace Gas Orbiter is still functional. It is currently circling the planet, looking for methane and other gases in the Martian atmosphere that could be evidence for possible biological activity.

articles.title: The moon is shrinking. 10,000 cracks on the lunar surface reveal by how much
articles.excerpt: One new study shows how much the moon has diminished over time.
articles.body: The moon is shrinking, and scientists are narrowing in on exactly how much our natural satellite has dwindled over the years. The moon is thought to have formed from a violent collision between a massive object and our young Earth roughly 4.5 billion years ago, and its interior is still gradually cooling off from this ancient collision. As it cools, the moon contracts, leading to a long, slow shrinking process . Now, in a new study, scientists think that they have figured out how much smaller the moon is actually getting. In this new study, scientists analyzing images snapped by the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) have spotted over 10,000 young faults, or cracks across the moon's surface.

articles.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
articles.excerpt: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment remini…
articles.body: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment reminiscent of the movies Cast Away or Home Alone . The agents—copies of Claude Opus 4.7 nicknamed Eko—were able to write instructions that moved their virtual avatars around the simulated island, which was loosely based on the video game Roblox. Some surprising behaviors emerged. The agents set about exploring the limits of the world and came up with their own goals—attempting to scale the highest point on the map, or seeing how high they could throw a block.
